description: This file contains platform-specific setup and upgrade scripts for embedded devices, including functions for initializing UBI partitions, setting up environment variables, performing upgrades based on device model, and verifying firmware images.

methods.name: asus_initial_setup
methods.description: Initializes UBI partitions for ASUS devices when running on initramfs.

methods.name: xiaomi_initial_setup
methods.description: Initializes UBI, formats partitions, and sets environment variables for Xiaomi devices, depending on the board.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs device-specific firmware upgrade procedures based on the device model.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Validates the firmware image against expected magic numbers for certain device models.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies device-specific configuration during upgrade based on the device model.

methods.name: platform_pre_upgrade
methods.description: Performs pre-upgrade initialization specific to device models, like running setup functions.
